title: Low-tier fallback ladder verified: HLTV identity research first, then esportsbook betting lines, then rating model, else blank
detail: For fixtures the featured Polymarket path does not resolve (sponsor/abbreviated names not silented), the originated ladder tries: 1) HLTV exact teams/time (https://www.hltv.org/matches) for identity + BO format only (fan votes never probability), 2) alias-joined Thunderpick paired prices (https://thunderpick.io/api/matches POST {gameIds:[6]}, margin removed), plus Kalshi/Bovada/Pinnacle where reachable, median consensus, 3) EGamersWorld aggregated average only as fallback (rejected on 1.80/1.80 placeholders), 4) Valve rating model (https://github.com/ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings, RD 75, uncalibrated), 5) HLTV ranking model or wide-book guidance, else blank. 2026-10-15 snapshot: 4 alias-joined Thunderpick lines closed the 4 featured gaps; 0 fixtures remain blank in the complete list. Every step logged in each match's research trail with source URL and status. Evidence: data/research/0582cbe9/fallback-ladder.json, data/origination.json, data/evidence/hltv-page.json, data/evidence/thunderpick-matches.json
